games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!
games.summary: Master Rule board (5 Main Monster, 2 Extra Monster, 5 Spell/Trap, Field zones), 8000 LP, one Normal Summon per turn, Level 5-6 needs 1 tribute and 7+ needs 2, no attacks on the first turn.

games.name: Zone Duel (demo cards)
games.summary: Anime-style duel: 5 monster zones, 8000 LP, one normal summon per turn, high-level monsters need tributes.

games.name: Mana Clash
games.summary: Mana-curve battler: free battlefield, 20 life, mana grows each turn, creatures can't attack the turn they arrive.
